clues.it: Tea era nella 10ª colonna, nella 1ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Luca.
clues.en: Tea was in the 10th column, in the 1st row and in a different room from Luca.

clues.it: Rosa era l'unica persona su un tappeto e a ovest di Vito.
clues.en: Rosa was the only person on a rug and west of Vito.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 4ª colonna, nella 3ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Irene.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 4th column, in the 3rd row and in a different room from Irene.

clues.it: Vito era accanto a delle catene e a nord di Bruno.
clues.en: Vito was beside loose chains and north of Bruno.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 7ª colonna, nella 5ª riga e in Armeria.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 7th column, in the 5th row and in the Armory.

clues.it: Irene era nella 8ª colonna, nella 6ª riga e in Armeria.
clues.en: Irene was in the 8th column, in the 6th row and in the Armory.

clues.it: Luca era accanto a una libreria, a uno sgabello e a nord di Anna.
clues.en: Luca was beside a bookcase, a stool and north of Anna.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Elena era l'unica seduta su una sedia e a ovest di Luca.
clues.en: Elena was the only one sitting on a chair and west of Luca.

clues.it: Anna era nella 10ª riga e accanto a delle catene.
clues.en: Anna was in the 10th row and beside loose chains.

clues.it: Marta era accanto a uno sgabello e a ovest di Bruno.
clues.en: Marta was beside a stool and west of Bruno.

clues.it: Dario era accanto a un tappeto e da solo in Biblioteca, ma non era accanto a un trono.
clues.en: Dario was beside a rug and alone in the Library, but was not beside a throne.

steps.it: L'indizio di Tea lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 10ª.
steps.en: Tea's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 10th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Ugo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 3ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Ugo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 3rd, column 4th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Sergio lascia una sola casella libera: riga 5ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Sergio's own clue leaves a single free square: row 5th, column 7th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Irene lascia una sola casella libera: riga 6ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Irene's own clue leaves a single free square: row 6th, column 8th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Anna lascia una sola casella libera: riga 10ª, colonna 12ª.
steps.en: Anna's own clue leaves a single free square: row 10th, column 12th.

steps.it: Irene può stare solo nella 6ª riga: escludendola, a Luca resta una sola casella: riga 7ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Irene can only be in the 6th row: ruling it out leaves Luca a single square: row 7th, column 2nd.

steps.it: Irene può stare solo nella 8ª colonna: escludendola, a Dario resta una sola casella: riga 12ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Irene can only be in the 8th column: ruling it out leaves Dario a single square: row 12th, column 9th.

steps.it: Luca può stare solo nella 7ª riga: escludendola, a Elena resta una sola casella: riga 9ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Luca can only be in the 7th row: ruling it out leaves Elena a single square: row 9th, column 1st.

steps.it: Vito può stare solo nella 11ª colonna.
steps.en: Vito can only be in the 11th column.

steps.it: Incrociando l'indizio di Rosa con quelli già usati resta una sola casella: riga 2ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Cross-checking Rosa's clue with the ones already used leaves a single square: row 2nd, column 3rd.

steps.it: Bruno può stare solo nella 8ª riga.
steps.en: Bruno can only be in the 8th row.

steps.it: Marta può stare solo nella 11ª riga.
steps.en: Marta can only be in the 11th row.

steps.en: Rosa can only be in the 2nd row: ruling it out leaves Vito a single square: row 4th, column 11th.

steps.en: Rosa can only be in the 3rd column: ruling it out leaves Marta a single square: row 11th, column 5th.
